{{Quote|Give up! It's all over!''"<br />"''We're here to take you away!|Two Exogen-class dark troopers arresting a pair of pirates|<ref name="SWG:TMotH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Mark of the Hero|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Exogen-class dark trooper''' was a model of the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Card">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Exogen-Class Dark Trooper}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Exogen-class_dark_trooper.jpg|left|thumb|An Exogen-class dark trooper]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> some units were deployed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and went to arrest two [[Sand slum pirates|pirates]] that the local ranchers [[Roric Goldenfield|Roric]] and [[Helen Goldenfield]] had captured.<ref name="SWG:TMotH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Mark of the Hero|Tatooine}}</ref> They also acted as law enforcement troopers in various cities.
